fills.researcher_notes: SNGPL's own 'Province-Wise Transmission Breakup' table (Transmission System page, as of 30 June 2025) lists, under PUNJAB, Sr#78 'FSD - MALIKWAL', diameter 30 in, MainLine = 90.82 km — an exact match to the sheet's LengthKnown (90.82) AND Diameter (30). This is a live, current, textual SNGPL asset register (distinct page from the two 2022/2020 map refs already on the row), so it upgrades the sourcing without changing the value. Not marked 'high' because it is still a single organization (SNGPL, the pipeline's own owner) rather than two independent bodies, but it is the primary asset holder's own current figure and matches to the hundredth of a km. Given this exact match, the drawn geojson route (122 km geodesic, ratio 1.35) is the more likely error, not LengthKnown — see validity note below; recommend no change to the length value.

Searched SNGPL AnnualReport-2023 (sngpl.com.pk/web/download/AnnualReport-2023/SNGPLAR2023.pdf, downloaded and full-text searched locally with pdftotext) for 'Faisalabad' and 'Malakwal' together, and separately for a Faisalabad-Malakwal project narrative in the report's illustrated project-history timeline (which runs project-by-project from roughly 2001 to 2023) — no mention of this specific line; the timeline's earliest entries suggest it only covers post-2001 expansions, so a pre-2001 line like this would not appear in it at all. Checked SNGPL's 'Year Wise Increase in Transmission System' table (sngpl.com.pk, Transmission System page) — it gives only network-wide cumulative totals by year (1994-2026), no per-segment breakdown or commissioning dates. Tried OGRA (ogra.org.pk) licensing pages directly — returned HTTP 403 to automated fetch (blocked, not confirmed-absent). This session's WebSearch quota was exhausted before broader news-archive search (Dawn, Business Recorder, The News, Pakistan Economic Survey) could be run on this specific row — that is an access gap, not a finding that no such reporting exists. UNRESOLVED; a full-text search of a WebSearch-capable session, or an SNGPL annual report from a much earlier fiscal year, is the next step.

validity.recommendation: Do not change LengthKnown (90.82 km exact-matches SNGPL's own current asset register). Instead flag the drawn route geometry for a future route-creation/redraw pass: the digitized geojson measures 122 km, 35% longer than the true 90.82 km FSD-MALIKWAL 30in line, which is the classic signature of a schematic straight-line digitization overshooting on a winding route, not a length error.
validity.researcher_notes: See fills[0] for the exact-match source. RouteAccuracy is already 'very low (straight line/schematic)', so no further downgrade is needed; the finding is only that a future redraw, not a length edit, is the correct fix.
